v.1: By those [angels] who wrest [the soul] violently,
v.2: by those who draw [it] out gently,
v.4: by those who, racing, take the lead,
v.5: by those who direct the affairs [of creatures]:
v.6: the day when the Quaker quakes
v.7: and is followed by the Successor,
v.8: hearts will be trembling on that day,
v.10: They will say, ‘Are we being returned to our earlier state?
v.11: What, even after we have been decayed bones?!’
v.12: They will say, ‘This is, then, a ruinous return!’
v.13: Yet it will be only a single shout,
v.14: and behold, they will be awake.
v.15: Did you receive the story of Moses,
v.16: when his Lord called out to him in the holy valley of Tuwa?
v.17: [And said,] ‘Go to Pharaoh, for indeed he has rebelled,
v.19: I will guide you to your Lord, that you may fear [Him]?’’ ’
v.20: Then he showed him the greatest sign.
v.22: Then he turned back, walking swiftly,
v.25: So Allah seized him with the punishment of this life and the Hereafter.
v.26: There is indeed a moral in that for someone who fears!
v.27: Is your creation more prodigious or that of the heaven He has built?
v.28: He raised its vault and fashioned it,
v.29: and darkened its night, and brought forth its forenoon.
v.30: Thereafter He spread out the earth,
v.31: brought forth from it its water and pastures,
v.33: as a [place of] sustenance for you and your livestock.
v.35: —the day when man will remember his endeavours
v.36: and hell is brought into view for those who can see—
v.37: as for him who has been rebellious
v.38: and preferred the life of this world,
v.39: his refuge will indeed be hell.
v.40: But as for him who is awed to stand before his Lord and restrains his soul from [following] desires,
v.41: his refuge will indeed be paradise.
v.42: They ask you concerning the Hour, “When will it set in,
v.43: considering your frequent mention of it?”
v.44: Its outcome is with your Lord.
v.45: You are only a warner for those who are afraid it.
v.46: The day they see it, it shall be as if they had not stayed [in the world] except for an evening or forenoon.
